symbols.name: butterfly map
symbols.meaning: The two-point map sending a pair of values to its half-sum and half-difference.
symbols.quote: The butterfly is the two-point map $H_0$, the basic step of the transforms in the multiplication method.

symbols.name: first input value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two input values of the butterfly.
symbols.quote: Let $\delta$ and $\theta$ be the two input values; the sources call them $u$ and $v$, but $u$ already denotes a field width.

symbols.name: second input value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two input values of the butterfly.
symbols.quote: Let $\delta$ and $\theta$ be the two input values; the sources call them $u$ and $v$, but $u$ already denotes a field width.

symbols.name: index bit
symbols.meaning: The index bit, a binary digit of the position, that the level of the transform processes.
symbols.quote: At the level for bit $b$, it acts on pairs of entries whose positions differ only in that digit.

relations.quote: The butterfly is an elementary step of the [discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md).
The butterfly is combined with [signed shifts](cyclic-shift.md), which rotate a record's coefficient list and change the sign of entries that wrap around.
